goal: Schritt 1: kleinsten gemeinsamen FieldType-Textkatalog mit fokussiertem Vertragstest extrahieren | Schritt 2: Web und TUI auf denselben Katalog migrieren und nur die direkt betroffenen Regressionen prüfen

guide_delta.summary: Web und TUI sollen dieselben verständlichen Namen für Feldtypen aus einer einzigen Quelle verwenden. Die Sicherheitsliste der in der TUI erlaubten Feldtypen bleibt davon getrennt.

direct_dependencies: I56 frozen maintainability rule: centralize only real shared semantic labels
I58 frozen TUI field-create safe-type policy
tests_required: Schritt 1: compile and run shared FieldType label contract test
Zwischen-Gate: shared catalog covers all ten current labels, supports enum/string input and safe fallback
Schritt 2: TUI seven-type selector labels remain unchanged but sourced from shared catalog
Schritt 2: Web field projection labels remain unchanged but sourced from shared catalog
tests_explicitly_not_run: full product suite because only shared presentation labels and their direct consumers change
database/domain/repository regressions because frozen core is untouched
manual 100/150/200 percent accessibility evidence because that remains I61
general text-registry work because I60 is limited to FieldType labels
risks: shared labels must not accidentally centralize TUI policy; the seven allowed create types remain local to the TUI
web fallback for unknown future field types must remain lossless
I60 must not grow into a general text registry or unrelated localization framework
non_changes: no change to which FieldTypes are creatable in TUI
expected_side_effects: Web and TUI display the same FieldType labels from one source after step 2
future label wording changes require one product-code edit instead of parallel Web/TUI edits
